capabilities: Track frontmost and open macOS apps automatically
Record daily session tables as Markdown files
Annotate sessions with notes in the daily note or recent files
View today, day, and month timelines with app-total bars
Draft a daily report and copy an LLM prompt to fill descriptions
extras: Automatic tracking is macOS-only and needs Automation and Accessibility permissions; it runs only while Obsidian is open, mobile is view-and-manual-log only. Was pending community-plugin review at time of writing, with BRAT install available.
motivation: The README says the point is not the automatic tracking itself but making it easy to leave a one-line note about what each session was for.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track time spent in applications or to log what each work session was for.
summary: Time tracker that automatically records the frontmost (and optionally all open) macOS apps as Markdown session tables, with day/month timeline views and manual logs.
